test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

PROTECT
solution: The correct answer is- **'​****Harm****' ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word **'****PROTECT'** is 'Harm'. • PROTECT: to keep someone or something safe from injury, damage, or loss (किसी को या किसी चीज़ को चोट, क्षति या हानि से सुरक्षित रखने के लिए) • *Example: clothing that **protects **you against the cold* • Harm: physical or other injury or damage (शारीरिक या अन्य चोट या क्षति) • *Example: A mistake like that will do his credibility a lot of **harm**.* • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Cover****:** to put or spread something over something, or to lie on the surface of something (किसी चीज़ को किसी चीज़ पर रखना या फैलाना, या किसी चीज़ की सतह पर लेटना) • **Keep****:** to have or continue to have in your possession (अपने कब्जे में रखना या जारी रखना) • **Secure****:** positioned or fixed firmly and correctly and therefore not likely to move, fall, or break (मजबूती से और सही ढंग से तैनात या तय किया गया है और इसलिए हिलने, गिरने या टूटने की संभावना नहीं है) 36:Te55, The correct answer is- **'Epilepsy****'**
